title: Studio
subtitle: Blog and media
slugHint: This is the public address segment. Leave it empty to generate one on publish.
slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, up to 80 characters.
languageNote: Blog language follows the site locale. It is not a field in these settings.
themesHint: The blog renders with the current theme. An installed theme takes effect after you pick Use; switching themes rebuilds the blog.
themeRemoveDetail: Uninstall deletes the theme files. If it is the current theme, the site switches back to the built-in theme and rebuilds.
themeSchemeHint: Blog pages don’t run the theme’s own scripts, so when the main site switches between light and dark, the page is switched for the theme as set here. This was detected on install — check that it’s right.
themeSchemeInvalid: Classes and values may only use letters, digits, - and _; the attribute must start with data-; dark and light must differ.
themeSchemeSaveFailed: Couldn’t save the dark mode setting.
themeRemoveCurrent: This is the current theme. Uninstalling it switches back to myriad-default and rebuilds.
themeUrlInvalid: Enter an http or https URL.
themeDrop: Drop a zip here, or click to choose
paramsHint: Written to [params] in the Hugo config. Each theme documents the keys it reads.
paramsInvalid: Theme params must be a JSON object.
hugoUnavailable: Hugo is not available on this server, so the blog cannot be built.
notesRssHint: Turn this on so published notes can be followed in any reader.
notesRssPrivate: The blog is not open to all visitors, so others cannot subscribe yet.
notesRssLoadFailed: Could not load the notes RSS setting.
companionHint: The blog rebuilds after generation, and the companion island appears at the bottom of the post.
companionLoadFailed: Could not load the AI companion status.
overlayHotkey: Press Alt+` to open or close the studio
overlayPostComments: {count, plural, one {# comment on this post} other {# comments on this post}}
overlayNotAPost: This page isn't a post. Write a new one, or open another tool from the toolbar.
